title: Ring document
description: The document published at ring.json: an envelope carrying its own version alongside the list of entries. Introduced once ring.json became a target for clients other than this app's own build — a packaged client or a future third party needs a version to check before it can safely assume anything about the entries it did not recognize. See docs/decisions.md, 'LOCKED: ring.json is a versioned envelope'.

version.description: The envelope's own shape version — whether a client can read `version`, `entries`, and nothing else without surprises. Independent of any individual entry's shape, which schema/ring.schema.json governs on its own. A client that does not recognize this value should still try to read `entries` rather than refuse the document outright: see src/lib/ring.js's `ringEntries`.
